quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means drivers in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What should you worry most about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your car might hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign means you must obey it. Where you see this sign, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong direction.
You may go if the road is clear.
You must come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the exact speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue forward or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue forward.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: A yellow panel that says "Exit only" means your lane does not continue through the interchange. The lane becomes an exit ramp. If you are in a lane under an "Exit only" sign, you can change lanes to continue forward, or you must exit the highway.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
Slow down because the road curves sharply ahead.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road curves sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves sharply ahead in the direction of the arrow. Before you reach a sharp curve, slow down as much as you would for a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells you that the right lane will be closed ahead due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic flows only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and stay farther away from the car ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Slow down to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Do not proceed until the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction areas. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is broken.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When conditions are poor, you must slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that these parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that lanes ahead are shifting. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Follow the detour to avoid hazardous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid hazardous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic is being rerouted due to a work zone. Follow the marked detour route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
The right lane ends ahead. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends ahead. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Be alert for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes are about to become one. Merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you construction work is coming. Drive carefully and watch for workers.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange signs with black lettering are construction signs. A detour sign tells you to take an alternate route because the main road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Drivers must merge smoothly between both lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the driver plus at least one passenger can use this lane.

questions.question: This sign stops traffic from:

options.text: Entering the wrong way on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering the wrong way on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has one-way traffic only. You cannot enter from the direction you are coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road conditions ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that a fire station is nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows you the direction traffic moves on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you to follow a different route because the main road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed for exiting an expressway.
The safe speed for entering an expressway.
The safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for exiting an expressway.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond sign:

options.text: Warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
Helps you find cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about construction work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. It is not safe. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign means that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign means you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign is posted in parking lots to show reserved spaces for people with a handicap permit, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your current speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start reducing your speed. The new speed limit will be shown on the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Two lanes of opposite traffic are about to merge.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Only stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and give the right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn of a school nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Obey any directions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even with a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even with a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers turning left that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass, even when the light is green.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This Keep Right sign tells you to stay on the side of the arrow. A barrier, median, or island is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal says it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Driving at 35 mph or slower is recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Driving at 35 mph or slower is recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead. It shows the direction of the curve and recommends driving at 35 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows a shared center lane. Drivers from both directions may only use this lane to turn left. Do not use it for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The road ahead is under construction or maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is under construction or maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns of construction or maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road has many curves ahead. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign alerts you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Be ready to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to warn about no passing zones.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. These object marker signs warn you about hazardous objects or areas you should avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign tells you a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can turn left or drive straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you about a bridge with narrow lanes ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that drivers must obey. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if emergency vehicles are coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always come to a full stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Come to a full stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they can turn right or continue straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (usually yellow with black markings). It tells you that the road will soon be divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means trucks cannot use this road. Drivers must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Flaggers direct traffic in construction areas. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: A yield sign is triangular. It means you must slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and give the right-of-way to traffic already in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming up. Get ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to watch for buggies.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted near intersections to tell drivers not to block them.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid blocking traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. If no one is next to you, move over one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a new lane is being added.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you will drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers that they cannot turn right on a red light at this traffic signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It tells drivers the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers the direction they must drive on this one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow diamond shape and black markings. It warns drivers to be extra careful when the road is wet because it may be slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It tells drivers that the road ahead has low clearance. Tall vehicles may not fit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It tells drivers to watch for traffic that may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully. You do not always have to stop.
Stop only for traffic on another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they will stop. If you follow this driver, be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to enter the roadway. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. If you see this sign, stop and turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the road.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turns are permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign means workers may be on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has several turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop for other drivers or pedestrians. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
